technology_name: MICROBIAL CONSORTIUM BASED CEMENT COMPOSITES FOR SUSTAINABLE SELF-HEALING AND IMPROVED STRUCTURAL PROPERTIES
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Micro-cracking in concrete structures allows water and salt ingress, leading to internal steel rebar corrosion and shortened lifecycle limits.
description: An advanced bio-composite cement material incorporating a specialized microbial consortium capable of continuously inducing Microbiologically Induced Calcium Carbonate Precipitation (MICCP) to seal newly formed voids and micro-cracks automatically.
applications: Submerged maritime concrete harbors, underground structural foundations, smart city high-rise outer walls, and maintenance-free highway bridge pillars.
secondary_sector: Advanced Materials & Chemical, Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Water, Environment & Waste Management, Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities
